_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions', 'We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2024 10-K); 'The markets in which we participate are highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: the company's own FY2024 10-K says 'the shift to cloud-based IT solutions and services, such as hyperscale computing, which may adversely affect the timing and volume of sales of our semiconductor products for use in traditional enterprise data centers'. At the same time it sells into data centers itself: 'We offer a broad set of Ethernet switching and routing products that are optimized for AI data center, service provider and enterprise networks'. The stock trades at 69.3x FY25E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of its enterprise storage and networking specifically.

classification.quality_note: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions', 'We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2024 10-K); 'The markets in which we participate are highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 4.89x; +104% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.55; conservative 2yr -37%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.0%/yr (worst year FY15-FY23 ex-FY16 ex-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.6%/yr (Q2 FY25 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY16 ex-FY18 ex-FY24 median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.8%/yr (FY15-FY23 ex-FY16 ex-FY18 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +104.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY23 ex-FY16 ex-FY18, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2025-05-16) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.89x (73.4% downside to Bear $60.86 / +15.0% upside to Bull $262.88) | Adj composite 3.32 vs market 2.77: gap +0.55 [UNDERVALUED] | +104% above the EPP floor $112.20 (34x FY25E $3.30) | Conservative 2-yr case: -36.8% total (-18.4%/yr) | At 69.3x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $302.34 sits above the BULL case; net revenue +24.7% YoY in Q1 FY25, forward revenues +19.3% (Q2 FY25 revenue guide (Q1 FY25 release)); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
